content: {"reasoning": "PR-204 is a patient-responsibility denial: the service is simply not covered under this self-funded plan. Authorization isn't required, retro-auth and peer-to-peer aren't offered, and a medical-necessity appeal was already tried and returned the same PR-204 — no payer avenue remains to convert this to plan coverage. Since a PR code assigns the balance to the patient, the correct disposition is to bill the patient for the non-covered service.", "action": "bill_patient"}
